_note: Owner muscle of whole-mesh tendons that have neither a cut spec nor a name that gives the muscle (see scripts/prepare-tendon-owners.mjs). Keep this list as short as possible.
_sheaths: Tendon sheaths, the dorsal compartments of the wrist and the palmar aponeurosis follow the muscle whose tendon they enclose. Key = structure name without Right/Left (lower case), value = the tendons (names without Right/Left); the owner muscles are those of the listed tendons (app/mj-tendon-owners.ts). Retinacula, ligaments, capsules and the vessel sheaths do not follow muscles.
